description:
next/ v4 — PHASE-0 ARCHITECTURE FIX: REAL ERP ProductionOrder (Level-3 OperationsRequest = PLAN/SOLL) via the sim-v5 ERP REST API (http://192.168.178.154:38260/api/orders), replacing the postgresql/erp-production-orders.json direct-erpdb poller (the forbidden direct-DB bypass). Same sourceId (edge SOURCE_IDS unchanged), same profile contract (SMProfile-ProductionOrder). BUG FIX: the old postgres source pointed at table erpdb.llm_test_v3.machineid_nodeid (a node-mapping table, not the FA backlog) — this REST source reads the real production-order shape (/api/orders, the same combined order row the Sim cramms Plan+Ist onto; this projection maps ONLY the PLAN fields + join key). production_order_no = identity/join key; article_no -> article_ref, machine_no -> machine_ref, geplante_stueckzahl -> qty_planned (SOLL), lieferdatum_soll -> planned_end_time, material_verfuegbar_ab -> material_ready_at. BONUS over the old source: cycle_time_planned_sec is a real REST key -> mapped (the old machineid_nodeid table had no cycle column). Customer demand denormalised on the order row: geplante_stueckzahl -> customer_order_qty + lieferdatum -> customer_due_date (the REST shape carries no separate kunde_bestellmenge/kunde_lieferdatum columns; on this combined projection the order qty IS the customer qty and lieferdatum IS the customer due-date — same semantic the postgres source served, without an impossible reverse-join). status arrives canonical/lowercase from the REST API -> mapped directly with NO valueMap (the postgres source had to normalise the coded integer order_status 1..5). MEASURED 2026-07-12 (full population, see the profile enum): through THIS binding exactly TWO values arrive — freigegeben and in_arbeit; storniert/abgeschlossen are cut by exclude_status, and offen/fertig do not exist anywhere in the ERP (0 of 47.513 rows). full_refresh change-detection (the REST API does not honour ?since — verified) — it-edge dedups via the per-id HWM on production_order_no. filter=null (full backlog per the cutover decision). Maps ONLY the PLAN fields + join key — the IST (produzierte_stueckzahl) is the dedicated OperationsResponse entity (erp-operations-response). Plan-vs-Ist (qty_shortfall) is the it-evaluator cross-source reconcile against OperationsResponse on production_order_no — this profile carries no constraints block. --- DISPATCH HORIZON 2026-07-31: sim-v5 now emits the dispatch horizon on this same REST shape (no new integration, per the consistency-wave request): planned_start_time (erp.order_operations.planned_start of the order's next non-terminal op) and dispatch_sequence (1-based per-machine queue position) are non-NULL only INSIDE the 24 h horizon; beyond it they are NULL and machine_no legitimately stays POOL-*. machine_no also now carries the PINNED physical machine inside the horizon instead of the POOL work_center, and resolves through factory.machine_canonical_id — with schemas V230 seeding sgm-06 -> sgm-006 and cnc-03 -> cnc-mtc-02, all 8 OT-published machines arrive under the id the OT itself presents, so the hand-declared translation on our side can be retired. parts_per_shot + mould_ref close the cavity-count gap: the count was previously recoverable only by dividing two part counters. READ parts_per_shot TOGETHER WITH cycle_time_planned_sec — the latter is a time per SHOT, so parts/h = 3600 / cycle_time_planned_sec * parts_per_shot. MEASURED on PROD sim 2026-07-31: 2394 orders in the horizon, 100 % with a planned start, 100 % with a sequence, 0 resolving to POOL-*, 55 distinct real machines. --- 2026-08-03 CORRECTION, MEASURED: the sentence above claiming 'storniert/abgeschlossen are cut by exclude_status' is WRONG. abgeschlossen comes from status_raw DELIVERED, and the filter this source sends (CANCELLED,INVOICED,SHIPPED) does not exclude it — so it PASSES THROUGH. Fully paginated over 10569 rows: in_arbeit 6877 (IN_PRODUCTION), freigegeben 3675 (WAITING_PARTS 3618 + ON_HOLD 57), fertig 12 (COMPLETED), abgeschlossen 5 (DELIVERED). The profile enum now declares all four. NOTE ON HOW THE OLD CLAIM SURVIVED: this endpoint caps a page at 5000 rows and the FIRST page carries only in_arbeit/freigegeben, so an unpaginated check confirms the wrong answer.

--- 2026-08-13, CAPT-ORDER — THIS SOURCE ABSORBS THE COMMERCIAL PROJECTION; sources/rest/erp-customer-orders.json IS WITHDRAWN. MEASURED TODAY against the live sim (.154): GET /api/orders and GET /api/customer-orders, same query string (?exclude_status=CANCELLED,INVOICED,SHIPPED&limit=500), return BYTE-IDENTICAL bodies — identical md5 (adbe865d603f1e27c562ae6054befb24), 665.809 bytes, 43 fields each, 500 rows each, and field-by-field over all 500 keys ZERO fields differ. On every one of the 500 rows the four id fields order_id, auftrag_nr, kundenauftrag_nr and production_order_no carry THE SAME STRING. There is no field anywhere in the upstream that is a distinct customer-order number. Two source declarations on one identical projection produced two entity types on ONE node id: measured in the KG on .99 today, 48.486 nodes carry BOTH :CustomerOrder and :ProductionOrder (100 % of :CustomerOrder — :CustomerOrder without :ProductionOrder = 0), and TRIGGERS is 48.485 edges of which 48.485 are SELF-LOOPS and 0 connect two nodes. The self-loop is mechanical, not accidental: erp-customer-orders declared idProperty=kundenauftrag_nr and an edge TRIGGERS(fkColumn=production_order_no) whose value on the same row is the SAME string, so it-edge's buildKgSnapshot emitted a relationship from the node to itself PLUS a stub {element_id: <same id>, entity_type: 'ProductionOrder'} that merged onto the node it came from. The L4->L3 chain 'customer demand triggers a manufacturing order' pointed at itself. The commercial attributes therefore move HERE, onto the one entity the upstream actually serves: kunde_id -> customer_ref, kunde_name -> customer_name, gesamtbetrag -> total_amount, waehrung -> currency, lieferdatum_soll -> due_date, geplante_stueckzahl -> quantity, and kundenauftrag_nr -> order_no. order_no is a COMPATIBILITY key, not a second identity: its value equals production_order_no on every row (that is the finding), and it is carried only so the consumers that read order_no today keep reading it. FOR_CUSTOMER moves here unchanged (fkColumn kunde_id, 100 % populated on the live feed). FOR_ARTICLE is carried over so the 48.490 order->article edges keep a producer; it duplicates PRODUCES from the same column and is a consolidation candidate, NOT part of this change. TRIGGERS is NOT carried over — that is the defect being removed. unit_price is deliberately NOT carried: the CustomerOrder profile declared it, /api/orders serves no such field, and it is set on 0 nodes in the live KG, so the it-evaluator's quantity x unit_price fallback for total_amount has never once fired for an order. NOTE the duplicate COLUMNS this introduces (geplante_stueckzahl -> qty_planned + customer_order_qty + quantity; lieferdatum_soll -> planned_end_time + due_date): a duplicate column is legal and already in use here, a duplicate smAttribute is not (lint-source-keys K6) and none is introduced.
